doc: Model drift after launch: degrade, shadow or abstain; the previous audit trail is preserved.

assertions.assert: a validated champion that drifts is degraded to shadow
a shadow champion that drifts is rolled back to abstain
no automatic retrain and earlier records unchanged
a decision after the alarm abstains DRIFT_ALERT
through the integration: a later decision after the alarm gets no number
the earlier FORECAST document is preserved byte for byte
